hebrewText: עֵ֤ת לְ/בַקֵּשׁ֙ וְ/עֵ֣ת לְ/אַבֵּ֔ד עֵ֥ת לִ/שְׁמ֖וֹר וְ/עֵ֥ת לְ/הַשְׁלִֽיךְ

tokens.bdb: time, especially (adverb with preposition) now, when, etc.
tokens.kjv: [phrase] after, (al-) ways, [idiom] certain, [phrase] continually, [phrase] evening, long, (due) season, so (long) as, (even-, evening-, noon-) tide, (meal-), what) time, when.

tokens.bdb: to search out (by any method, specifically in worship or prayer); by implication, to strive after
tokens.kjv: ask, beg, beseech, desire, enquire, get, make inquisition, procure, (make) request, require, seek (for).
